main_text.p: ficiunt commodis, ut qui se-met ad meliora tempora, & occasiones licitas servare po-tuissent, quo suâ virtute patriæ essent emolumento, suis forti-ter pugnando decori. Præter-quam, quod nec ejus gentis gloria minor sit, cujus in tali duello succubuit propugnator, ut nec ejus gentis major gloria, cujus promachus victor exsti-tit. Vt in vanum & temerarie talis paucorum decertatio pro nationis fortitudine suscipia-tur. Ne dicam, malè inferri de totius gentis fortitudine, ex unius virtute aut vitio: cum hic non liceat ex uno probasse, aut improbasse, cæteros totius gentis milites.
Quid quod ea vera fortitu-do non sit, animo & arte mili-tari contendere velle, nisi id fiat in hostem, in quem nos ar-matos voluit respublica; idque tempore opportuno, si quando in

page.notes: Catchword "in" is the first word of the next page and is printed at the foot, right of the signature. Printed text "suâ" and "ut nec ejus" appear as printed. Words "sese" appear as "se-met" with a hyphen at the line end, transcribed as printed. "probasse" and "improbasse" read as printed; the scan is slightly blurred at "probasse", so a [?] is appropriate: probasse[?]. Mild ink smudging at left margin; no marginal notes present.
